name: sat-pdf-audit
description: Parse authorized exam PDFs with a user-owned LlamaCloud key and audit the resulting deliverables.

interface.shortDescription: Parse exam PDFs and audit conversion integrity.
interface.longDescription: Uses each user's own LlamaCloud API key to parse authorized exam PDFs, preserve private raw evidence, and audit Markdown and HTML deliverables for structural and rendering defects.
interface.defaultPrompt: Parse an authorized exam PDF with my LlamaCloud key, then audit the generated deliverables.
